decisions.reason: Routing visitors to the corresponding location website is compatible with, but does not change, the existing separate-Wix-site architecture.
The source changes location-selection navigation and says nothing about payment accounts, payment isolation, or payouts.
The master site already serves as the national site with bookings handled by sibling location sites; the selector and routing details belong to the source Requirement and do not alter this role.
The source does not change template reuse, future-location extensibility, design consistency, or the Seattle template basis.
Directing visitors to either location website does not change the existing requirement for dedicated, consistently branded location experiences.
The homepage already includes a Location Selector and visible offerings; the instruction to keep the activities listed preserves rather than changes the current section composition.
A location-selection menu is a navigation behavior and does not change the selected visual references, style, layout characteristics, or cross-location design consistency.
The source names smashroomusa as the homepage but does not change the SMASH ROOM brand name, colors, logo usage, or cross-location branding.
The source routes users who want to book to location websites, which is consistent with the existing sibling-site booking host and does not change booking platform or activation rules.
Location routing does not modify isolation of bookings, databases, analytics, calendars, reporting, memberships, gift cards, revenue, sales, or staff access.
The source specifies homepage routing behavior but does not change the mobile-friendly design requirement.
Keeping the activities listed does not necessarily change the package catalog or pricing policies, and the source provides no package or price details.
